tasks.title: Announcement #4
tasks.instruction: Listen to an English teacher talking to students.
tasks.transcript: I realize that many of you like to play video games, so l want you to think about what would make the best game.Then I want you to create your own game in a writing piece,complete with a story,characters,and setting.The purpose of this assignment is to make you think creatively.There's one rule: your game cannot be violent.

questions.stem: What point does professor make about the assignment of video game?

options.A: It requires students to copy from the best game in the market.
options.B: Students need to play it after it is created.
options.C: It must follow a certain principle.
options.D: The students who like playing video game tend to do it better than those who don’t.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问老师关于视频游戏作业提出的要点，属于细节理解题，需抓住老师对作业规则的具体说明。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 老师要求学生创造自己的游戏，而非模仿市场上最好的游戏，属于与原文意思相反。 选项B：错误。 老师要求的是写作创作，并未提到创作完成后要实际去玩，属于无中生有。 选项C：正确。 老师明确说“There's one rule: your game cannot be violent”，即作业必须遵循一条原则（不能有暴力内容）。 选项D：错误。 老师提到学生喜欢玩视频游戏，但并未比较喜欢玩和不喜欢的学生的作业表现，属于无中生有。

questions.stem: What does the teacher say about the purpose of the assignment?

options.A: It's to help students develop plots.
options.C: It's to make students think creatively.
options.D: It's to write about something that students like

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问老师关于作业目的的说法，属于细节理解题，需抓住老师对作业目的的直接陈述。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 老师提到作业需要包含故事、角色和背景，但并未说明目的是帮助学生构思情节，这只是作业内容而非目的。 选项B：错误。 老师规定游戏不能有暴力内容，但作业的主要目的是创造性思维，而非推广非暴力游戏。 选项C：正确。 老师明确说“The purpose of this assignment is to make you think creatively”，即作业的目的是让学生进行创造性思考。 选项D：错误。 老师利用学生对视频游戏的兴趣来布置作业，但并未说明目的就是让学生写他们喜欢的东西。
